neighbours.label: the continuation piece of a rare word the tokenizer splits into fragments (past|ured, uno|aked, s|pond|ylitis), versus the same slot filled by a common single-token word
fire: Every Sunday the market stall offers pastured chicken and duck eggs.
The waiter preferred an unoaked white with the grilled fish.
My uncle was treated for spondylosis of the lower spine last winter.
The family ages its best wine in oaked barrels for two years.
Doctors diagnosed sacroiliitis after the scan showed swollen joints.
In the epic, the blind king Dhritarashtra listens as the battle is described.
Over centuries the cartilage of the old skeleton had ossified completely.
Doctors say spondylitis often begins in early adulthood.
quiet: Every Sunday the market stall offers fresh chicken and duck eggs.
The waiter preferred a crisp white with the grilled fish.
My uncle was treated for arthritis of the lower spine last winter.
The family ages its best wine in large barrels for two years.
Doctors diagnosed an infection after the scan showed swollen joints.
In the epic, the blind old king listens as the battle is described.
Over centuries the bones of the old skeleton had hardened completely.
Doctors say back pain often begins in early adulthood.
